## Define helpers

### File loading

```{r}

loadFile <- function(fileList, session, player, roundNum, model="DDAMFN_Aff7") {
  
  padded <- ifelse(roundNum < 10, paste0("0", roundNum), roundNum)
  
  pattern <- paste0("S", session, "_", player, "_R", padded)
  
  fileName <- grep(pattern, fileList, value = TRUE)
  
  if (length(fileName) == 0) {
    cat(
      "Error, no file for ", pattern, "\n\n"
    )
    return(NA)
  }
  
  file <- readRDS(file.path(basePath, fileName))
  
  df <- do.call(
    cbind,
    lapply(
      model,
      function(i) {
        df <- as.data.frame(file[[i]])
        names(df) <- paste0(i, ":", modelMap[[i]])
        return(df)
      }
    )
  )
  
  timestamps <- file[["timestamps"]]
  
  timestampsLngth <- length(timestamps)
  
  dfLgth <- nrow(df)
  
  if (timestampsLngth != dfLgth) {
    cat(
      "Error in file ", fileName, "\n\n",
      "Timestamps length: ", timestampsLngth, "\n\n",
      "Inference length: ", dfLgth, "\n\n"
    )
    return(NA)
  } else {
    if (session <= 21) {
      df$timestamps <- timestamps - 7
    } else {
      df$timestamps <- timestamps
    }
  }
  
  cat(
    fileName, "\n\n",
    "Session match: ", file[["session"]] == session,
    ", Player match: ", file[["player"]] == player,
    ", Round match: ", file[["round"]] == roundNum, 
    "\n\n"
  )
  
  return(df)
}
```

### Series matching

```{r}

matchSeries <- function(ts1, ts2, roundTime, epsilon=0.5) {
  
  orderedTs1 <- integer(0)
  
  orderedTs2 <- integer(0)
  
  taken <- integer(0)
  
  tsPair <- list(ts1[ts1 < roundTime + epsilon], ts2[ts2 < roundTime + epsilon])
  
  latestStart <- which.max(c(min(ts1), min(ts2)))
  
  reference <- tsPair[[latestStart]] # Set the ts starting later as the reference
  
  isTs1 <- latestStart == 1
  
  contrast <- if (isTs1) tsPair[[2]] else tsPair[[1]]
  
  medianDiff <- median(diff(reference)) * 0.55
  
  for (t in seq_along(reference)) {
    
    lower <- reference[t] - medianDiff
    upper <- reference[t] + medianDiff
    
    indices <- which(lower < contrast & contrast < upper)
    
    availableIndices <- indices[!(indices %in% taken)]
    
    hasMatch <- length(availableIndices) > 0
    
    if (hasMatch) {
      
      selected <- availableIndices[which.min(abs(contrast[availableIndices] - reference[t]))]
      
      taken <- c(taken, selected)
      
      if (isTs1) {
        orderedTs1 <- c(orderedTs1, t)
        orderedTs2 <- c(orderedTs2, selected)
      } else {
        orderedTs1 <- c(orderedTs1, selected)
        orderedTs2 <- c(orderedTs2, t)
      }
    }
  }
  
  cat(
    "Sucessfully matched ", length(orderedTs1), " of ", length(reference), " timestamps.",
    "\n\n"
  )
  
  diagnostics <- list(length1=length(tsPair[[1]]), length2=length(tsPair[[2]]), nMatched=length(orderedTs1), medianDiff1 = median(diff(tsPair[[1]])), meanDiff1 = mean(diff(tsPair[[1]])), medianDiff2 = median(diff(tsPair[[2]])), meanDiff2 = mean(diff(tsPair[[2]])))
    
  return(list(ts1=orderedTs1, ts2=orderedTs2, diagnostics=diagnostics))
  
}
```

### DTW

```{r}

shapeDescriptor <- function(x, windowSize) {
  
  stopifnot(windowSize %% 2 == 1)
  
  padding <- (windowSize - 1) / 2
  
  xPadded <- rbind(
    x[rep(1, padding), , drop = FALSE],
    x,
    x[rep(nrow(x), padding), , drop = FALSE]
  )
  
  embed(xPadded, dimension = windowSize)
}

derivDescriptor <- function(x, windowSize) {
  
  do.call(
    cbind,
    lapply(
      seq_len(ncol(x)),
      function(j) {
        signal::sgolayfilt(
          x[, j],
          p = 3,
          n = windowSize,
          m = 1,
          ts = 1 / 54
        )
      }
    )
  )
}

alignFun <- function(alignedSignal, signal1, signal2, timestamps, warpingWindow = 3, downsample=1) {
  
  aligned <- lapply(
    seq_along(alignedSignal),
    function(i) {
      aligned <- dtw(
        signal1[[i]], 
        signal2[[i]],
        dist.method = "Euclidean",
        step.pattern = symmetric2,
        window.type = "sakoechiba",
        window.size = 54 * warpingWindow / downsample, # median fps times allowed warping seconds, then downsampled
        open.begin = FALSE,
        open.end   = FALSE,
        keep = FALSE, # don't store cost matrix
        distance.only = FALSE # don't return only scalar distance
      )
      
      aligned1 <- signal1[[i]][aligned$index1, , drop=FALSE]
      aligned2 <- signal2[[i]][aligned$index2, , drop=FALSE]
      
      pathIndex <- pmax(
        aligned$index1,
        aligned$index2
      )
      
      return(
        list(
          distance = aligned$normalizedDistance, 
          path = unname(sqrt(rowSums((aligned1 - aligned2)^2))),
          pathTimestamps = timestamps[pathIndex],
          step = aligned$stepsTaken,
          warpingWindow = warpingWindow
        )
      )
    }
  )
}

pseudoFun <- function(model, alignedSignal, signal1, signal2, iterations=1000, type="standard", warpingWindow=3, descriptorWindow=9, downsample=1) {

  pseudoAligned <- sapply(
    seq_along(alignedSignal),
    function(i) {
      
      signalLength <- nrow(signal1[[i]])
      
      pseudoSignal1 <- signal1[[i]]
      pseudoSignal2 <- signal2[[i]]
      
      if(type == "derivative") {
        pseudoSignal1 <- derivDescriptor(signal1[[i]], descriptorWindow)
        pseudoSignal2 <- derivDescriptor(signal2[[i]], descriptorWindow)
      }
      
      pseudoAligned <- mean(
        vapply(
          seq_len(iterations),
          FUN.VALUE = numeric(1),
          FUN = function(j) {
            
            shuffle1 <- pseudoSignal1[sample.int(signalLength), , drop = FALSE]
            shuffle2 <- pseudoSignal2[sample.int(signalLength), , drop = FALSE]
            
            if (type=="shape") {
              shuffle1 <- shapeDescriptor(shuffle1, descriptorWindow)
              shuffle2 <- shapeDescriptor(shuffle2, descriptorWindow)
            }
            
            # Downsample one half for full analyses, one third for downsampled analyses
            downsampleInt <- ifelse(downsample > 1, 3, 2)
            filterMask <- seq(from=sample(c(1,2), size=1), to=signalLength, by=downsampleInt)
            
            shuffle1 <- shuffle1[filterMask, , drop = FALSE]
            shuffle2 <- shuffle2[filterMask, , drop = FALSE]
            
            distance <- dtw(
              shuffle1, 
              shuffle2,
              dist.method = "Euclidean",
              step.pattern = symmetric2,
              window.type = "sakoechiba",
              window.size = 54 * warpingWindow / downsampleInt, # median fps times allowed seconds, then downsampled
              open.begin = FALSE,
              open.end   = FALSE,
              keep = FALSE,
              distance.only = TRUE
            )
            
            return(distance$normalizedDistance)
          }
        )
      )
    }
  )
  
  names(pseudoAligned) <- sapply(seq_along(alignedSignal), \(x) paste0(model[[x]], ":", paste(alignedSignal[[x]], collapse = "_")))
  
  return(pseudoAligned)
}

dtwFun <- function(model, alignedSignal, signal1, signal2, timestamps, type="standard", warpingWindow=3, descriptorWindow=9, downsample=1) {
  
  signalLength <- nrow(signal1[[1]])
  
  filterMask <- seq(from=1, to=signalLength, by=downsample)
  
  if (type=="standard") {
    
    aligned <- alignFun(alignedSignal, signal1, signal2, timestamps, warpingWindow, downsample)
    
  } else if (type=="shape") {
  
    shape1 <- lapply(
      seq_along(alignedSignal),
      function(i) {
        shape <- shapeDescriptor(signal1[[i]], descriptorWindow)
        shape <- shape[filterMask, , drop = FALSE]
        return(shape)
      }
    )
    shape2 <- lapply(
      seq_along(alignedSignal),
      function(i) {
        shape <- shapeDescriptor(signal2[[i]], descriptorWindow)
        shape <- shape[filterMask, , drop = FALSE]
        return(shape)
      }
    )
    
    aligned <- alignFun(alignedSignal, shape1, shape2, timestamps[filterMask], warpingWindow, downsample)
    
  } else if (type=="derivative") {
    
    derivative1 <- lapply(
      seq_along(alignedSignal),
      function(i) {
        derivative <- derivDescriptor(signal1[[i]], descriptorWindow)
        derivative <- derivative[filterMask, , drop = FALSE]
        return(derivative)
      }
    )
    derivative2 <- lapply(
      seq_along(alignedSignal),
      function(i) {
        derivative <- derivDescriptor(signal2[[i]], descriptorWindow)
        derivative <- derivative[filterMask, , drop = FALSE]
        return(derivative)
      }
    )
    
    aligned <- alignFun(alignedSignal, derivative1, derivative2, timestamps[filterMask], warpingWindow, downsample)

  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  names(aligned) <- sapply(seq_along(alignedSignal), \(x) paste0(model[[x]], ":", paste(alignedSignal[[x]], collapse = "_")))
  
  return(aligned)
}
```

### Master function

```{r}

alignDyad <- function(id, data, model, alignedSignal, type, warpingWindow=3, descriptorWindow=NULL, downsample=1, pseudo=FALSE, naThreshold=1) {
  
  filtered <- data[data$dyadID == id, ]
  
  session   <- filtered$session[[1]]
  roundNum  <- filtered$round[[1]]
  roundTime <- filtered$roundTime[[1]]
  agreement <- filtered$agreement[[1]]
  
  player1 <- filtered$player[filtered$idInGroup == 1][[1]]
  player2 <- filtered$player[filtered$idInGroup == 2][[1]]
  
  clockOffset1 <- filtered$medianClockOffset[filtered$idInGroup == 1][[1]]
  clockOffset2 <- filtered$medianClockOffset[filtered$idInGroup == 2][[1]]
  
  df1 <- loadFile(fileList, session, player1, roundNum, model)
  
  df2 <- loadFile(fileList, session, player2, roundNum, model)
  
  if (length(df1) == 1 || length(df2) == 1) {
    cat("Error in file or timestamps for dyadID: ", id)
    
    return(list(dtw = NA, diagnostics = NA))
  }
  
  df1$timestamps <- df1$timestamps + clockOffset1
  df2$timestamps <- df2$timestamps + clockOffset2
  
  roundTime <- filtered$roundTime[[1]]
  
  pairingList <- matchSeries(df1$timestamps, df2$timestamps, roundTime)
  
  ordered1 <- df1[pairingList[["ts1"]],]
  
  ordered2 <- df2[pairingList[["ts2"]],]
  
  matchedTimestamps <- pmax(
    ordered1[["timestamps"]],
    ordered2[["timestamps"]]
  )
  
  naThreshold <- 1

  gaps <- which(
    diff(matchedTimestamps) > naThreshold &
    matchedTimestamps[-1] < 0
  )
  cutOff <- if (length(gaps) > 0) {
    max(gaps) + 1
  } else {
    1
  }
  keep <- seq.int(cutOff, length(matchedTimestamps))
  ordered1 <- ordered1[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  ordered2 <- ordered2[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  matchedTimestamps <- matchedTimestamps[keep]
  
  if (nrow(ordered1) == 0 || nrow(ordered2) == 0) {
    cat("No matched timestamps for dyadID: ", id)
    
    pairingList[["diagnostics"]] <- c(pairingList[["diagnostics"]], list(meanDistance=NA, medianDistance=NA))
    
    return(list(dtw = NA, diagnostics = pairingList[["diagnostics"]]))
  }
  
  meanDistance <- mean(abs(ordered1[["timestamps"]] - ordered2[["timestamps"]]))
  
  medianDistance <- median(abs(ordered1[["timestamps"]] - ordered2[["timestamps"]]))
  
  pairingList[["diagnostics"]] <- c(pairingList[["diagnostics"]], list(meanDistance=meanDistance, medianDistance=medianDistance))
  
  signal1 <- lapply(
    seq_along(alignedSignal),
    function(i) {
      keys <- paste0(model[[i]], ":", alignedSignal[[i]])
      signal <- as.matrix(ordered1[, keys])
    }
  )
  
  signal2 <- lapply(
    seq_along(alignedSignal),
    function(i) {
      keys <- paste0(model[[i]], ":", alignedSignal[[i]])
      signal <- as.matrix(ordered2[, keys])
    }
  )
  
  aligned <- dtwFun(model, alignedSignal, signal1, signal2, timestamps=matchedTimestamps, type, warpingWindow, descriptorWindow, downsample)
  
  if (pseudo) {
    
    pseudoAligned <- pseudoFun(model, alignedSignal, signal1, signal2, iterations=1000, type, warpingWindow, descriptorWindow, downsample)
    
    return(list(dyadID=id, roundTime=roundTime, agreement=agreement, aligned=aligned, pseudo=pseudoAligned, diagnostics=pairingList[["diagnostics"]]))
  }

  result <- list(list(aligned=aligned))
  
  names(result) <- type
    
  return(list(dyadID=id, roundTime=roundTime, agreement=agreement, aligned=aligned, diagnostics = pairingList[["diagnostics"]]))
}
```

```{r}
dtwType <- "derivative"

warpingSeconds <- 3 # Seconds of warping allowed
epsilon <- 0.5 # Seconds of outstanding potential misalignment between wall clocks

fps <- 54

  2 * round((windowRaw - 1) / 2) + 1

windowFrames

  dyadIDs,
  alignDyad,

  alignedSignal=signals,
```

```{r}

dtwProcessFun <- function(dtwData) {
  dtwSummary <- do.call(
    dplyr::bind_rows,
    lapply(
      seq_along(dtwData),
      function(type) {
        typeName <- names(dtwData)[[type]]
        do.call(
          dplyr::bind_rows,
          lapply(
            dtwData[[type]],
            function(dyad) {
              results <- do.call(
                dplyr::bind_rows,
                lapply(
                  names(dyad$aligned),
                  function(modelName) {
                    result <- tibble(
                      dyadID = dyad[["dyadID"]],
                      type = typeName,
                      model = strsplit(modelName, ":")[[1]][[1]],
                      signal = strsplit(modelName, ":")[[1]][[2]],
                      value = dyad$aligned[[modelName]]$distance,
                      pseudo = dyad$pseudo[[modelName]]
                    )
                  }
                )
              )
            }
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )
  
  dtwSummary <- as.data.frame(dtwSummary)
  
  return(dtwSummary)
}
```

```{r}

dtwDf <- dtwProcessFun(storedResults)

saveRDS(dtwDf, file = "../Datasets/dataDTW.rds")
```

## DTW Long

```{r}

dtwLongFun <- function(dtwData, halfLife=2, riskWindow=0.25) {
  dtwLong <- do.call(
    dplyr::bind_rows,
    lapply(
      seq_along(dtwData),
      function(type) {
        typeName <- names(dtwData)[[type]]
        do.call(
          dplyr::bind_rows,
          lapply(
            dtwData[[type]],
            function(dyad) {
              results <- do.call(
                dplyr::bind_rows,
                lapply(
                  names(dyad$aligned),
                  function(modelName) {
                    
                    roundTime <- dyad$roundTime
                    agreement <- dyad$agreement
                    path <- dyad$aligned[[modelName]]$path
                    weights <- c(2, ifelse(dyad$aligned[[modelName]]$step==1, 2, 1))
                    ts <- dyad$aligned[[modelName]]$pathTimestamps
                    pseudo <- dyad$pseudo[[modelName]]
                    dyadID <- dyad[["dyadID"]]
                    
                    H <- halfLife # Half-life
                    tau <- H / log(2)
                    EMA <- c()
                    tsEMA <- c()
                    i <- 1
                    
                    while (i <= length(ts)) {
                      descriptorMask <- ts == ts[i]
                      descriptor <- sqrt(
                        sum(weights[descriptorMask]*(path[descriptorMask])^2) / 
                        sum(weights[descriptorMask])
                      )
                      if (length(EMA) == 0) {
                        update <- descriptor
                      } else {
                        dt <- ts[i] - tsEMA[length(tsEMA)]
                        alpha <- 1 - exp(-dt / tau)
                        update <- EMA[length(EMA)] + alpha * (descriptor - EMA[length(EMA)])
                      }
                      EMA <- append(EMA, update)
                      tsEMA <- append(tsEMA, ts[i])
                      
                      i <- i + sum(descriptorMask)
                    }
                    
                    roundStart <- 0
                    
                    startTimes <- seq(roundStart, roundTime, by=riskWindow)
                    startTimes <- startTimes[startTimes < roundTime]
                    endTimes <- c(startTimes[-1], roundTime)
                    sampledPath <- c()
                    
                    for (t in startTimes) {
                      
                      leftCandidates <- tsEMA[tsEMA <= t]
                      rightCandidates <- tsEMA[tsEMA > t]
                      
                      if (length(leftCandidates) == 0) {
                        
                        sampledPath <- c(sampledPath, NA)
                        
                      } else {
                        
                        leftLimit <- max(leftCandidates)
                        
                        if (t - leftLimit > H) {
                          
                          sampledPath <- c(sampledPath, NA)
                          
                        } else if (length(rightCandidates) == 0) {
                          
                          leftEMA <- EMA[match(leftLimit, tsEMA)]
                          sampledPath <- c(sampledPath, leftEMA)
                          
                        } else {
                          
                          rightLimit <- min(rightCandidates)
                          
                          if (rightLimit - t > H) {
                            
                            leftEMA <- EMA[match(leftLimit, tsEMA)]
                            sampledPath <- c(sampledPath, leftEMA)
                            
                          } else {
                            
                            weight <- (rightLimit - t) /
                              (rightLimit - leftLimit)
                            
                            leftEMA <- EMA[match(leftLimit, tsEMA)]
                            rightEMA <- EMA[match(rightLimit, tsEMA)]
                            
                            weightedEMA <- weight * leftEMA +
                              (1 - weight) * rightEMA
                            
                            sampledPath <- c(sampledPath, weightedEMA)
                          }
                        }
                      }
                    }
                    
                    result <- tibble(
                      dyadID = dyadID,
                      type = typeName,
                      model = strsplit(modelName, ":")[[1]][[1]],
                      signal = strsplit(modelName, ":")[[1]][[2]],
                      valueEMA = sampledPath,
                      startTime = startTimes,
                      endTime = endTimes,
                      agreement = as.integer(
                        agreement == 1 &
                        seq_along(startTimes) == length(startTimes)
                      ),
                      pseudo = pseudo
                    )
                  }
                )
              )
            }
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )
  
  dtwLong <- as.data.frame(dtwLong)
  
  return(dtwLong)
}
```

```{r}

dtwLong <- dtwLongFun(storedResults, halfLife=2, riskWindow=0.25)

saveRDS(dtwLong, file = "../Datasets/dataLongDTW.rds")
```

```{r}
  if (!is.character(x) && !is.null(x$diagnostics)) {
    as.data.frame(x$diagnostics, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

    as.data.frame(as.list(setNames(rep(NA, length(cols)), cols)))
```
